_comment: Curated earnings dates per symbol, YYYY-MM-DD, confirmed dates only.
This file ships EMPTY on purpose. There is no earnings endpoint in the
Alpaca CLI, and guessed dates would silently authorise trades on numbers
nobody checked. A symbol absent from `events` is reported as UNKNOWN by
agent/earnings.py — never as clear — and the decision log records which.
To populate: add confirmed dates from the issuer's investor-relations
page or your data vendor, then commit the file. Dates in the past are
harmless; the lookup only considers dates on or after today.
